verdict.rationale: There is thin evidence of a third-party ecosystem. A community comment points to Gemini being available through the OpenRouter router (gemini-comm-5). The official SDK repo recommends Gemini API Skills for third-party coding assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor (gemini-gh-1, gemini-gh-2). OpenAI-library compatibility (gemini-docs-8) lowers the barrier for third-party tools to integrate. missing for 10: evidence of curated community lists (e.g. awesome-lists), a broad set of independently maintained third-party tools and integrations, signals of active community maintainers, and independent corroboration that the ecosystem is lively.
